name: Fresh Pineapple Chunks (Woody Fiber & Bromelain Warning)
whyItWorks: Fresh pineapple contains coarse, woody insoluble fibers and a potent protease enzyme called bromelain. While bromelain aids digestion in healthy guts, in ulcerated Crohn's/Colitis it stings open raw mucosal sores and accelerates cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid raw fresh pineapple during flare-ups. In deep remission, select well-cooked canned pineapple crushed fine in 100% juice (cooking denatures the caustic bromelain enzyme).
watchOuts: Coarse fibrous threads can tangle and bromelain enzyme burns ulcerated mucosal tissue.
